column4: 奇跡的にケイブリスに勝てた場合
column5: If you miraculously manage to defeat Kayblis,

column4: やった・・やったぞ、カオスも大喜び
column5: I did it... I did it! Chaos is overjoyed too.

column4: まさかケイブリスを倒すなんて、すげー
column5: I can't believe I defeated Kayblis, awesome!

column4: 喜んでいた所に報告が来る
column5: Just as I was celebrating, a report arrived.

column4: 美樹ちゃんが・・美樹ちゃんが・・魔王になってしまった。
column5: Miki-chan... Miki-chan has become the Demon King.

column4: その後、魔王美樹によりランスは殺され・・世界は暗黒に落ちる
column5: After that, Rance was killed by Demon King Miki... and the world fell into darkness.
